bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
docker inspect "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo STK04_BOT_ABSENT; exit 61; }
state="$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$name")"
test "$state" = running || { echo STK04_BOT_NOT_RUNNING; exit 62; }
logs="$(docker logs --tail 150 "$name" 2>&1 || true)"
if ! printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$';then
 echo STK04_DM_POLL_READY_NOT_VERIFIED
 exit 63
fi
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 64
cursor="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_poll_cursor"' 2>/dev/null)" || exit 65
test "$cursor" -ge 0 || exit 66
echo STK04_DM_PROCESS=RUNNING
echo STK04_DM_POLL_READY=PASS
if test "$cursor" -gt 0;then echo STK04_DURABLE_UPDATE_CURSOR=YES;else echo STK04_DURABLE_UPDATE_CURSOR=EMPTY;fi
docker inspect -f 'STK04_BOT_RESTART_COUNT={{.RestartCount}}' "$name"
docker logs --tail 50 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_(DM|GATE|POLL)_' | tail -n 8 || true
